properties.description: Applies strictly to the fresh pre-invocation initial instance observation before scan k=0 (INITIAL_INSTANCE scope).
The alarm persists during fault and hold.
Each valid rising fault shifts the bounded history.
Held faults and invalid inputs do not create records.
Normal runtime counts only eligible intervals.
Alarm releases when neither fault nor hold remains.

Every constrained ACTUAL output satisfies the exact pinned input-driven reference transition and comparison policy. Finite observations can falsify this predicate; no completed unbounded proof is claimed.

atomic_propositions.rise: valid AND fault AND NOT previous(valid AND fault)
atomic_propositions.same_stats: count and history equal pre-scan values
atomic_propositions.hold: Internal hold timer active (<500ms since last valid rising fault edge) while THICKNESS_SIGNAL_VALID is TRUE.
atomic_propositions.normal: valid AND NOT fault AND CUTTING_RUN
atomic_propositions.CompleteBehavior:
令(Sref[k+1], E[k])=T_PUB012(Sref[k], deepCopy(I[k]), dt_ms[k])。T由normalized_specification.transition列出的固定Python源码和初始状态精确定义。CompleteBehavior[k] 当且仅当所有constrained_observed_fields均存在于实际O[k]，且分别满足comparison关系。Sref只由采样输入推进，绝不由O或候选内部变量推进。
validFault=VALID & FAULT，其新上升沿count加1，历史=[FaultTimestamp]+旧历史前4项，并记录hold起点。无效清hold；alarm=valid & (fault或hold年龄<500ms)。valid & !fault & CUTTING_RUN时runtime加CycleTime（约定与dt_ms一致），否则保持。初始count/runtime=0、历史五个0、previousValidFault=FALSE。计数/累计不得溢出，FaultTimestamp为DINT。
atomic_propositions.THICKNESS_ALARM: O[k].THICKNESS_ALARM: independently observed post-scan candidate value (BOOL); never defined as expected output.
atomic_propositions.Slab_Fault_Counter: O[k].Slab_Fault_Counter: independently observed post-scan candidate value (UINT); never defined as expected output.
atomic_propositions.Slab_Runtime_Accumulator: O[k].Slab_Runtime_Accumulator: independently observed post-scan candidate value (LTIME); never defined as expected output.
atomic_propositions.Slab_Fault_History: O[k].Slab_Fault_History: independently observed post-scan candidate value (ARRAY[0..4] OF DINT); never defined as expected output.
atomic_propositions.timing: Internal hold start Sref.timed_contract.since records the most recent valid THICKNESS_FAULT rising-edge timestamp; a fresh rising edge during an active 500ms hold restarts the 500ms timer. Invalid input clears hold immediately.
atomic_propositions.init: At the separate pre-invocation initial observation before scan k=0: O_init.THICKNESS_ALARM=false, O_init.Slab_Fault_Counter=0, O_init.Slab_Runtime_Accumulator="LTIME#0ns", O_init.Slab_Fault_History=[0, 0, 0, 0, 0].
